scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n db,public,admin -c gray,blue,yellow "npm run dev-db -w @enjaz/core" "npm run wait-db -w @enjaz/core && npm run dev -w @enjaz/public" "npm run wait-db -w @enjaz/core && npm run dev -w @enjaz/admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @enjaz/public && npm run build -w @enjaz/admin
scripts.start: concurrently -n public,admin "npm run start -w @enjaz/public" "npm run start -w @enjaz/admin"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @enjaz/core && npm run typecheck -w @enjaz/public && npm run typecheck -w @enjaz/admin
